description: List every establishment in the Adaga direct-booking network (hotels, and soon salons/restaurants) with brand, type, city and slug. All of them expose real-time availability, exact prices and real booking creation — no OTA commission: the traveler always pays the establishment's exact direct price, and the establishment keeps the customer relationship (OTAs take 15-25% AND own the customer). No authentication required, no rate limit, no pagination — the complete directory is returned in one response. Use the slug for network_search and network_book.
name: network_directory
